messages:
marta: heads up: noticed per-customer provisional token spikes tied to short-lived socket reconnects from our websocket proxy. looks like ~2 tokens per reconnect getting logged.

kai: can you paste one trace? is this streaming-toolcall or the plain /v1/run path?

marta: streaming-toolcall. trace:
```
2026-08-11T08:03:12Z proxy: conn=42 drop -> reconnect new_sid=Z12 old_sid=Y99
2026-08-11T08:03:12Z router: route=fast-us orig_customer=acct-21 provisional=2 reason=prefix
2026-08-11T08:03:12Z backend: session=Z12 accept -> ledger: provisional row created
```

sanjay: hmm, similar to earlier ALB probe noise but this is user sockets flapping. why is provisional tied to orig_customer instead of current account? we had account-migration flow that re-tags sessions.

marta: exactly. repro: customer A migrated route mid-session -> origin tag mismatch, provisional credited to old acct, confirmed to new acct. finance will hate us.

dev-bot: ticket created INFRA-2150 (socket-probe-ledger-mismatch)

kai: root causes I see: (1) proxy issues new session ids on reconnect without propagating original_session_id header (2) ledger tombstone TTL (30s) shorter than our reconnect/resume window in some mobile clients (3) metadata re-tag (account migration) race where origin_customer != final_customer.

sanjay: mitigation ideas: a) propagate x-original-session-id + x-origin-customer at router so backend can attribute provisional correctly OR b) always tag provisional with both origin_customer and final_customer when available and use reconciliation to reattribute.

marta: prefer (b) for auditability: keep provisional rows but include both customer tags and a `reassignable=true` flag so reconcile job can move charges post-confirmation. console PM: want a visibility tile showing "provisional reassignable vs locked"?

console-pm: yes please. we'd like a small table and a Sankey showing origin->final customer flows for provisional groups. toggle to include/exclude reassignable rows in billing views. CON-667 opened.

finance-team: must have CSV export of any reassignable provisional groups and an approval workflow before auto-reassign/refund to avoid accidental revenue change. Also we need a cutoff window (48h?) after which auto-reassign is allowed if not disputed.

kai: proposed plan: (1) router to emit x-original-session-id and x-origin-customer when known (FF behind) (2) backend to store provisional row with tags: origin_customer, current_customer, orig_session, reason (reconnect|probe|truncate) (3) ledger schema store tags as string arrays (for now) and mark reassignable=true if origin_customer!=current_customer (4) reconcile job groups reassignable provisional cohorts and waits 48h for disputes then issues transfer entries and CSV for finance.

sanjay: also fix tombstone TTL to 2 minutes for websocket flows so dedupe works across short reconnects. maybe make TTL configurable by route type.

marta: tests: simulate account-migration mid-stream + socket flapping and ensure provisional->confirmed lands on final_customer and ledger shows lineage. measure false reassign rate with a mixed traffic sim (10% migrators, 10% mobile flaps). target <0.5% misassign.

console-pm: for UX add a "provisional lineage" column and a filter for reason tags. will add sample trace links.

finance-team: also require final audit CSV before any refunds; we'll keep auto-reassign off until finance signs off.

kai: rollout: implement tags & longer tombstone behind FF, enable console lineage in beta for SREs, run reconciler in dry-run mode for 7 days to produce CSVs but not apply changes, then finance signoff.

marta: scheduling INFRA-2150 work tonight, console changes next week. thanks team.

sanjay: one more: add metric "provisional_reassignable_rate" per-route and alert if >1% sustained over 1h so ops notices migration anomalies.

dev-bot: created CON-667, INFRA-2150, BILL-674. closing this thread, followups in tickets.
